title: Specimen Acceptance, Rejection and Recollection Offers — Laboratory Test Orders
content:
## Acceptance criteria

Each service class of Laboratory Test Orders draws its tests on the class's primary specimen type. A specimen is rejected when it fails any acceptance criterion:

- hemolysis;
- a volume below the class's minimum specimen volume;
- missing or mismatched labels;
- arrival after the class's room-temperature stability limit from collection, or after its refrigerated stability limit when shipped refrigerated;
- the wrong container;
- leakage in transit.

## Effect of a rejection

A rejection returns the order to *received*: it again awaits a specimen. The patient and the ordering provider are told within the class's rejection-notice period in business days.

## Whether a recollection is offered

A recollection is offered only when the order's recollection count (the recollection requests already on the order) is below the class's maximum number of recollections and the class does not require a new requisition for a recollection. Both facts come from the order's own history and its service class.

| Recollection count below the class maximum | New requisition required by the class | Recollection offered |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Yes |
| No (count has reached the maximum, or the class maximum is 0) | No | No |
| Yes or no | Yes | No |

## When no recollection is offered

When no recollection is offered, no recollection request is written. The order is cancelled by the laboratory with the reason *recollection not completed*, and every uncredited charge line is credited with the reason *specimen rejected, not recollected*. A class that needs a new requisition is re-ordered by the provider as a new order.

## When a recollection is not completed in time

When the recollect-by date passes without a new accession, the laboratory cancels the order on the following day, with the same reason and the same credits.

**Example (hypothetical).** A class allowing two recollections has an order whose specimen is rejected for the third time, after two recollection requests. The count (2) has reached the maximum, so no request is written; the order is cancelled with the reason *recollection not completed* and its uncredited lines are credited.

## Retired clause on the recollection request

> *No longer in force.* The former clause read: "When a recollection is offered, one recollection request line is written for that rejection with the recollect-by date equal to the rejection date plus the class recollection window in calendar days (the rejection date being day 0); the recollection itself is collected at no charge to the patient."

That clause is no longer in force: it has been superseded by the current basis for recollection requests and no longer fixes the recollect-by date. The remaining sections of this policy stay in force.

superseded_clauses: When a recollection is offered, one orders_recollection_requested line is written for that rejection with recollect_by_date equal to the rejection date plus recollection_window_days calendar days (rejection date = day 0); the recollection itself is collected at no charge to the patient.
